title: enabled: false does not hide a project handler from help, while the dispatcher refuses it
body:
Found by the 2026-09-21 doc audit (dc's independent read, finding K1).

`enabled: false` wins over everything, a project handler of the same name included: `docs/configuration.md`, `lib/config.reference.yaml` and `intent/llm/ARCHITECTURE-shell.md` all say so, and the dispatcher honours it -- `bin/devbin <name>` exits 2 naming the file. `help` did not. `known_commands` (lib/resolve) lists config's commands through `command_active`, then every `cmd/<name>` handler WITHOUT asking it, so a switched-off handler was listed by `help` and answered by `help <name>`: help offered a command the dispatcher refuses.

Fix: the handler pass asks `command_active` too, the one reading of `enabled: false`. Test: tests/unit/dispatch.bats, "a project handler switched off with enabled: false is neither listed nor answered by help", driven red at the parent commit.


## Resolution

Fixed at `b58d1ee`, test driven red first at its parent commit. Full suite 1578/1579 at `ae3b200`: the one failing arm was environment-caused (GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS=0 exported in the running shell defeated readonlygit.bats' stale fixture, and its control arm caught it) and is green in a clean environment; that file is hardened at `ad86870`. Reviewed by vc against this issue; vc's mutants on 0099 and 0104 were killed. Ships in 0.1.4.
